general_information.subject: GNK ASG inquiry received
general_information.body:
Thank you for contacting GNK ASG d.o.o.

Your inquiry has been received. For public information, please refer to the official GNK ASG portal and GNK ASG Insights archive. If your message requires a formal response, it will be reviewed and answered through the appropriate channel.

public_documents.subject: GNK ASG public documents inquiry
public_documents.body:
Thank you for your inquiry regarding public documents or sources.

Please refer to the Documents and Sources sections of the GNK ASG portal. If you require a specific document or clarification, please provide the exact topic, requested document name and intended use.

business_cooperation.subject: GNK ASG cooperation inquiry
business_cooperation.body:
Thank you for your cooperation proposal.

Please provide a short company profile, the proposed cooperation area, the contact person, relevant links and any deadline or expected next step. The inquiry will then be reviewed.

meeting_request.subject: GNK ASG meeting request
meeting_request.body:
Thank you for the meeting request.

Please provide the proposed topic, participants, preferred time window, meeting format and a short agenda. Availability can then be reviewed and a suitable next step proposed.

technical_support.subject: GNK ASG portal support request
technical_support.body:
Thank you for reporting a portal-related issue.

Please provide a screenshot, the page URL, device and browser information, and a short description of what happened. This will help us review the issue.

review_required.subject: GNK ASG inquiry under review
review_required.body:
Thank you for your message.

This inquiry requires review before a substantive response can be provided. A reply will be prepared after the relevant information has been checked.
